message: Header accepts an 11-byte store; get_u32(buf + 8) then reads buf[8..11], one byte past the end. The fixed bound is len < 12.
File-controlled count is used as the loop bound and as an index into g_accounts[MAX_ACCOUNTS] (256) without a cap; a crafted store writes past the global array (CWE-787).
Record copy uses off = 12 + i*88 without checking off/off+88 against len; a short store causes an out-of-bounds heap read.
